top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Fall as Oil, Yields Climb While Walmart Slumps
top_signals.summary: US stock futures were lower ahead of the market open on Thursday as a rally in government bond sputtered, sending yields higher, and oil prices rose. Walmart Inc.’s earnings disappointed, pressuring shares of the retail giant and peers.
